name: glassy-ui-base-nova
title: Glassy UI components for shadcn/ui (base-nova)
description: Replaces shadcn/ui's base-nova components (Base UI (@base-ui/react)) with Glassy UI versions that keep their API, so your imports stay as they are.

light.glassy-gloss: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.02), transparent 65%), linear-gradient(rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08), transparent 45%)

[data-slot='alert']:is([data-variant='de.box-shadow: var(--glassy-raised), inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--glassy-src-destructive) 40%, transparent)

[data-slot='alert']:is([data-variant='de.background-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--glassy-src-destructive) 14%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--glassy-src-background) 88%, transparent))

[data-slot='badge'].background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--glassy-chip) 14%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--glassy-src-background) 88%, transparent))
[data-slot='badge'].box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.5), inset 0 0 0 0.5px color-mix(in oklab, var(--glassy-chip) 40%, transparent)

:is([data-slot='input'], [data-slot='tex.transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease

[data-slot='kbd'].box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.5), inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(var(--glassy-edge) / var(--glassy-edge-alpha)), 0 1px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.16)

[data-slot='tabs-list'][data-variant='de.transition: left 0.6s var(--ease-glassy-spring, ease), top 0.6s var(--ease-glassy-spring, ease), width 0.6s var(--ease-glassy-spring, ease), height 0.6s var(--ease-glassy-spring, ease)

[data-slot='button']:not([data-variant='.background-image: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 43%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.01), transparent 70%), linear-gradient(rgb(255 255 255 / 0.35), transparent 60%)

[data-slot='button']:is([data-variant='d.box-shadow: 0 1.8px 2px -1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--glassy-accent) 40%, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4)), 0 6.7px 10px -5px color-mix(in oklab, var(--glassy-accent) 40%, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4))

docs: Glassy UI components installed over components/ui: Glassy UI's look and lens with shadcn/ui's API. Remove the Glassy UI theme first if you installed it. Install with --overwrite after committing your work: it replaces local edits in those files. Guide: https://glassyui.com/guides/shadcn-theme
